balanced_placement.bucket_order: Enumerate factor index tuples lexicographically in the listed factor orders, append each to its desired-placement bucket.
balanced_placement.case_order: For round0..15, emit the next tuple from bucket0,bucket1,bucket2,bucket3; serial=4*round+placement_index.
balanced_placement.remaining_limitation: Placement is a deterministic balanced blocking factor, not a replicated independent fifth factor; interactions are not independently identified.

case_bank.serialization: JSON array, sorted object keys, indent2, final newline

identities.RNG: Original numpy.Generator(PCG64(seed_integer)); instantiate only after admission.
identities.seed_sha256: Full64-character lowercase SHA256 hex of the complete ASCII case_id

outputs.activity_interpretation: ALL-active across three ON scans is stricter than single-ON recovery; ANY-active is a union. Activity groups have independent noise draws and must not be described as a paired causal comparison.
outputs.existing_measured_method_evidence: Describe retained A/B matched-RFI, noise, transient and near-OFF diagnostic outcomes as results from failed qualification; no reruns or replacement controls.
per_case_required: all six retained max score/drift/width maps and geometry
all raw ON threshold carriers and OFF classifications/witnesses
whole-child resource receipt and committed artifact hashes
per_cell_measures: global ON maxima for threshold misses
raw ON hit and surviving hit counts
outputs.plots_if_produced: Discrete observed cells/counts only, labeled n=1 per cell and exploratory; no smoothed/interpolated sensitivity boundary or calibrated efficiency curve.
outputs.report_denominators: Report all64 prespecified cells, completed valid counts, missing/integrity/resource failures and recovery counts separately; incomplete zero placeholders are not measured nonrecovery or rejection.

prior_exposure.known_loss_stage: No originating ON threshold hit; retained maxima below frozen ON threshold10.

purpose: Describe fixed-method recovery versus declared strength, drift, intrinsic width and ON activity after failed qualification; identify pre-ON versus localization versus OFF losses without tuning.

resources.admission_resource_inequality: actual remaining period CPU >= admitted METHOD aggregate allocation + retained report/reproduction CPU margin; charged CPU plus outstanding reservations must remain within both allocation and period ceiling.
resources.reservation_and_refund: Reserve before child submit; charge complete child startup/search/finalization from actual reaped usage, or charge full partition if complete usage cannot be proven; refund only after durable closure.
resources.stop_and_retention: No submit without capacity for a full250-second reservation; retain every incomplete/failed/unsubmitted identity, never redraw, rerun or introduce a second correction.

unchanged_science.OFF_rule: Exactly frozen endpoint-coupled all-compatible-template search; raw ON hits retained regardless of OFF outcome.
unchanged_science.normalization_and_source_timing: Exactly the unchanged original frozen contract and detector; all six16-row scans, signed native df and absolute cadence gaps retained.
unchanged_science.recovery_rule: Exactly frozen truth endpoint localization at originating ON first/last integration midpoints; report ALL-active and ANY-active separately before and after OFF.
unchanged_science.signal_profile: Frozen uniform intrinsic top-hat convolved with integration-duration frequency sweep using exact bin CDF differences; signal present for all16 rows in each declared active ON scan only.
unchanged_science.strength_definition: Per active scan A=nominal_ideal_box_score*0.25/B, B the frozen noiseless unfiltered true-track ideal-box projection; declared score is neither measured detector SNR nor physical flux.
